text: dsh-scenery（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为会话工作区添加可自定义的氛围背景。它在设置页注册背景控制，并在会话区域的图片层上合成底部黑色渐变和输入框周围的柔和光晕。用户可上传壁纸或指定图片 URL，调整图片适配、位置、缩放、模糊和透明度，并实时预览后保存。背景默认关闭，适合希望调整 DSH 工作区视觉氛围的用户。设置与上传图片保存在 DSH 用户目录，不需要 API 密钥或额外账号。

dsh-scenery (DSH Web plugin) adds an image backdrop, bottom gradient and composer aura to the workspace. Users can upload wallpaper or enter an image URL, adjust its appearance in Settings, and preview changes. Settings and uploaded images are stored in the DSH home directory.
想给 DSH 会话区域换一张自选背景图。
Can I soften the workspace with a gradient and a glow around the composer?
dsh-scenery 的功能「场景背景」：在会话工作区后方显示图片，并叠加底部渐变与输入框光晕。用户可在设置中上传图片或填入 URL，调整显示参数并即时预览。
dsh-scenery 使用所填的 http(s) 图片 URL 作为背景，浏览器会从该地址加载图片。
dsh-scenery 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 63 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-scenery README · dsh-scenery：Capy-style **ambient background** for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) workspace —
an image, a very large bottom black gradient, and a soft radial “aura” around
the composer, so the UI looks like it is *sitting inside the scene* instead of
floating on a flat colour.

> conversation column. It does not redesign anything, does not touch the
> layout of existing components, and — unless you flip the switch — changes

dsh-scenery README · dsh-scenery：> Screenshots above show the effect live in DSH. Crank the opacity up and the
> image, bottom gradient and composer aura sit clearly behind the conversation;
> dial it right down and you get just a whisper of atmosphere — enough to make

dsh-scenery README · What it does：Layering (bottom → top):

```
① your image                (fit / pan / zoom / blur / opacity)
② large bottom black gradient   (soft, no bands; grows gradually, the last
                                 ~20–30% approaches black)
③ radial “aura” around the composer (very soft ellipse, black centre fading

The aura tracks the *real* composer seat inside the conversation column
(sticky bottom bar), so it stays glued to the input area as you resize the
window or drag columns.

dsh-scenery README · Controls (Settings → Scenery background)：| Setting | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Enable | master switch — off by default |
| Image | upload a local picture (`PUT` to the host, stored under your DSH home) **or** paste an `http(s)` image URL |
| Fit | `cover` (crop-to-fill) / `contain` / `fill` |
| Position X/Y | object-position pan, % |
| Zoom | extra scale, 0.5×–3× |
| Overall opacity | dims image + overlays together toward the app surface |
| Bottom gradient strength | peak blackness of the big bottom gradient |
| Bottom gradient height | how much of the stage the gradient spans (from the bottom) |
| Aura strength | blackness of the composer aura |
| Aura size | ellipse radii multiplier |
| Aura offset X/Y | fine-tune aura centre relative to the auto-tracked composer |
| Image blur | gaussian blur of the image only — UI text stays crisp |

dsh-scenery README · Controls (Settings → Scenery background)：Every control previews live; **Save** persists to the host. There is also a
**Reset** (restores defaults and clears the current image) — it asks once
before it commits.

Persistence: `~/.dsh/dsh-scenery/config.json` (+ uploaded `wallpaper.*` file,
or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-scenery/` when `DSH_HOME` is set). A localStorage mirror
makes the background apply instantly on page load before the config round
trip.

dsh-scenery README · Install：Published on npm as `dsh-scenery` (this repo).

```bash
dsh-scenery README · official CLI (any profile)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-scenery

dsh-scenery README · or straight from this repo:：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-scenery@github:wbaws/dsh-scenery
```

Restart / reload DSH, open **Settings → Scenery background**, pick an image,
flip **Enable**. Done. (No code from Capy is used — only the general visual
technique, re-implemented in plain CSS.)

dsh-scenery README · How it works (brief)：- Locates the conversation workspace through the official slot anchor `[data-slot="conversation"]` (no hard-coded class names). - Inserts **one** absolutely positioned `z-index:-1`, `pointer-events:none`, `aria-hidden` stage as the first child of the conversation host. The host is made its own stacking context (`isolation:isolate`), so the stage paints *above* the host's flat background colour but *under every message and panel*. Nothing else in the app is modified. - The stage holds an `` (fit/pan/zoom/blur) plus a scrim div whose `background` stacks the aura radial-gradient over the bottom linear-gradient. Both gradients are generated from the settings with many interpolation stops → smooth falloff, no banding. - `ResizeObserver` + window resize keep geometry fresh; the composer seat is found by scanning for the sticky-bottom element inside the conversation host (cached, cheap). - If the conversation seat isn't mounted yet (or was replaced by another plugin), it falls back to compositing onto the AppFrame element's own background layers — still zero DOM/layout changes. - On disable/unload everything is removed

dsh-scenery README · How it works (brief)：**Host half** (`lib/index.js`, Cordis plugin `scenery`): a small fenced route
prefix `/dsh-scenery-bg` that persists config and wallpaper bytes
(GET/PUT/DELETE config, PUT/GET wallpaper). Zero platform peer deps — plain
Node builtins only, path-traversal-safe.

**Settings UI**: registers one section into the official
`settings.section` slot (id `scenery-config`), styled with the DSH alias
tokens so it follows the active theme.

npm run build   # concatenates src/client/* -> lib/client.js + syntax checks
npm run check

dsh-scenery README · open preview/index.html in a browser (uses window.SceneryCore from lib/client.js)：```
lib/index.js            host half (Cordis plugin: persistence routes)
lib/client.js           built client bundle (do not edit)
src/client/00-defs.js   defaults / sanitizers / i18n
src/client/01-composite.js  pure gradient + aura math (shared with preview)
src/client/02-runtime.js    DOM engine (stage, tracking, modes)
src/client/03-settings-ui.js  settings section
src/client/04-entry.js   module-loader entry + window.SceneryCore
preview/index.html       standalone preview / tuning page
```

dsh-scenery README · Compatibility：Targets the official DSH web client (works in the DSH Desktop app window and
the web GUI). Requires a DSH profile with the client plugin system (same base
as `dsh-pet`, `dsh-better-sidebar`, etc.). If you find an incompatibility,
please open an issue with your DSH version.

dsh-scenery README · License：MIT. “Capy” styling is used purely as a visual reference; this is an
independent, from-scratch implementation of the general gradient technique.
